system.name: ToolkenGPT
system.one_liner: Represents each tool as a token ('toolken') whose learned embedding is appended to the LM head, so a frozen LLM calls tools like words and completes arguments in a tool mode.

content.variant_note: one math question followed through reasoning, tool and execution boxes with real text and numbers, next to the LM-head table that holds the toolkens
content.argues: A frozen LLM picks a tool like a word through toolken embeddings in its head, fills arguments in a tool mode, runs the tool and writes the result back.
content.subject: A garden-area question solved by predicting the square toolken, completing its argument 16 in tool mode and receiving 256 from execution.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a new token type by appending hue-coded rows, with icon and bracket, under the ordinary vocabulary in the output-embedding table; then run one worked example through titled mode boxes joined by three numbered dashed arrows that close a loop.
lessons.suits: Methods that add vocabulary items, actions or special tokens to a language model and switch modes at inference, such as tool use, retrieval or special tokens.

evidence: Toolken embeddings are appended to the language model head like regular word tokens.
the LLM switch to the “tool mode”, which provides a few demonstrations of the same tool to complete the arguments.

summary: ToolkenGPT lets a language model call a very large set of tools without fine-tuning it: each tool becomes a token, a toolken, with a learned embedding appended to the LM head. Figure 1 puts that table on the left: grey word-token rows with knowledge-base, math and robot toolkens added in orange, blue and pink, plus a bar column for the next-token distribution. On the right a garden-area question runs through a Reasoning mode box, a Tool mode box with demonstrations and an Execution step, joined by three numbered dashed arrows (mode switch, call the tool, fill in text) that return 256 to the blank.
summary_zh: ToolkenGPT把每个工具当成一个词元并学习其嵌入，追加到语言模型输出头。图1左边是词表嵌入表（词元加三组彩色工具词元和概率条），右边用一道数学题走完推理、工具、执行三步。
notes: Primary kind changed from the pre-screen's model-anatomy to worked-walkthrough because the larger right part follows one instance through numbered steps; the left table is the model-anatomy part. Frozen status is stated in the title and text, not in the figure.
